newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases on arbitrage, T-bill demand ends.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases on arbitrage, T-bill demand ends.

text.p: The rouble eased in lively trading on Wednesday on speculative long-covering and dealers said demand had decreased after Treasury bill investors had set aside funds for today sales.
roubles/dollar Jul 16 midday Jul 16 early Jul 15 close
"The dollar was traded at the lower limit of the central bank's range on Monday and Tuesday," one dealer said. "Today's speculative rise on short-covering is a normal market correction."
The rouble lost additional support after banks had raised funds they needed for today's government securities sales, dealers said.

"Demand for rouble overnight credits, seen earlier this week, was due to buying by some major banks ahead of the auctions," ABN-Amro Bank dealer Artur Lotov said. "Credit rates are going today in line with those of rouble/dollar."
On Wednesday the Finance Ministry is offering eight trillion roubles of 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills and 10 trillion roubles of 728-day OFZ interest-bearing bonds.
